title: Self-Pay Visit Package Forfeitures and Appointment Series Late-Arrival Fees
content:
Revenue Cycle memo on the patient's Self-Pay Visit Package history and the late-arrival fee on an Appointment Series.

**Rule.** The late-arrival package-forfeit share is 150 percent where the patient's Self-Pay Visit Package history shows two or more package visits forfeited for missed appointments in the three months up to the assessment date (an entry counts when fewer than three whole months separate its date from the assessment date), 125 percent where it shows exactly one, and 100 percent where it shows none. The share is read as a percentage of the late-arrival basis and multiplies it.

**Records read.** Forfeited package visit entries in the patient's Self-Pay Visit Package history and their dates.

**Applying it (hypothetical).**

- One forfeited package visit in the three months: 125 percent; on a basis of USD 62.50, USD 78.125 before the final rounding.
- No Self-Pay Visit Package, or no forfeiture in the period: 100 percent.
- Assessment on 15 July: a forfeiture dated 16 April counts; one dated 15 April does not.
